subject: POC trial environment options and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acmeai.com>
Cc: SaaS Ops <ops@acmeai.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (POC environment)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off: 

1) Success criteria (please confirm):
   - 95th percentile latency < 400ms for your 1k tokens demo workload
   - End-to-end token cost reduction >= 30% vs current setup
   - Model quality parity (BLEU/ROUGE style checks + 10 sample prompts)
   - Integration tests passing in your CI with our API

2) Suggested evaluation plan & timeline:
   - Week 0: Environment provisioned + sample dataset ingress (you)
   - Week 1: Baseline tests and initial tuning (Redwood + Acme)
   - Week 2: Throughput/latency runs + integration validation
   - Week 3: Final report + decision

3) Environment options (we discussed these on the call):
   - Hosted sandbox: fastest to start (ours hosted infra, quick credentials) — recommended if you want to validate functionality and latency quickly.
   - Dedicated sandbox: reserved GPU slice for consistent throughput, useful if you want to validate sustained RPS and cost at scale.
   - VPC trial (hosted VPC): customer-managed networking, good for sensitive data — longer setup (network & security review).

Attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (POC checklist & minimal artifacts we need from your side).

Can you confirm the success criteria above and which environment you prefer to start with? Also confirm the approximate teams/owners on your side for ingress and CI validation.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and the extra success criterion (output stability) — I've added that to the plan. Here's a concrete evaluation plan and ownership matrix so everyone is aligned: 

Evaluation plan (detailed):
- Day 0 (provisioning): Redwood provides Hosted sandbox credentials + API keys; we provide a short runbook for ingress.
- Day 1-4 (baseline & functional): run 10k sample prompts, check quality parity and stability; integration tests run in your CI.
- Day 5-9 (performance): run throughput tests at target RPS; if 95th latency or cost targets aren't met, schedule a Dedicated sandbox spin-up.
- Day 10-14 (reporting): final tuning, cost/latency report, and recommendations.

Ownership: 
- Acme: data ingress (SaaS Ops) and CI gating (Alex)
- Redwood: environment provisioning, baseline tests, model tuning, and final report (Marissa + DevEng)

Environment guidance: 
- Hosted sandbox: ~24-48 hours to provision (fastest), minimal setup work from Acme.
- Dedicated sandbox: provisioning timeline ~2-3 business days (reservation of GPU slice & quota), used for sustained throughput validation. Temporary costs may apply if we allocate dedicated capacity for the trial — I'll loop in Viv for an exact quote.
- VPC trial: typically 1-2 weeks due to network & security review; recommend only when you need private network egress or strict data residency.

Next steps (action items):
1) Alex: Confirm you want Hosted sandbox to start (reply with OK).
2) SaaS Ops: Share sample dataset and CI access (links or service accounts).
3) Redwood (Marissa): Once Alex confirms, I'll request Hosted sandbox creds and start the baseline run. I'll also open an internal ticket to get a Dedicated sandbox quote on standby.

Related links: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-789 and a shared runbook at https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Day 0 once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa
